license.decision: User chose MIT and delegated recommendation on 31 October 2026.

supported_matrix.platform_scope: Only exact measured local configuration is accepted; hosted CI must establish its own declared matrix.

held_out.initial_exposure: Initial authors and reviewer saw the original packet before sealing.
held_out.retuning_after_access: Forbidden for unbiased comparison; a failure-informed change requires a fresh reviewed held-out revision.

comparison.runtime_input: query, trusted tenant/collection and declared filters only; reviewed support/state/answerability never supplied to retrieval or planning
comparison.assessment: No held-out anchors or label-derived policy. Unconfigured coverage remains unknown. Report conservative abstention, not semantic-assessor calibration.
comparison.planner: Deterministic identifier-preserving query-only variants; no answer-derived rewrites.
comparison.corpus: All approved immutable revisions in the selected split, active pointers and historical filters preserved.

live_embeddings.policy: explicit transport, no model installation, no synthetic vector under real identity

live_reranking.policy: same authorized shortlist before/after; model alias mutable

comparison.reproducibility: Record model responses once, then replay same outputs through both native libraries. Replay parity is not independent live-provider inference.

quality_targets.intervals: 95 percent Wilson on binary diagnostics; macro denominators for rank/support. Report all failures and null denominators.
quality_targets.claim_limit: Small pre-exposed synthetic suite, no broad model superiority or population guarantee.

resource_targets.policy: Import latency ceilings 3x prior same-machine fresh-process observations; RSS/install ceilings 2x. No OS-cold-cache or cross-platform inference. Stop load if system memory free below 10 percent, responsiveness deteriorates or swapping persists.

live_limits.data: Only approved original public synthetic evaluation documents/queries; no private pilot/user documents.
live_limits.pricing: Verify dated official prices and exact token admission before dispatch; actual account billing remains unknown unless independently supplied.

developer_trial.comparison: Manual native PostgreSQL retrieval vs installed Cragkit, same synthetic corpus, scope and source-fidelity requirements.
tasks: Immutable update or required-filter configuration change
developer_trial.success: Record each complete task, elapsed time, errors, attempts and assistance; no relaxed invariants. Comparative effort target is Cragkit time no greater than the measured baseline.
developer_trial.participant: Unfamiliar human developer required for human usability evidence; agent rehearsal cannot substitute.
developer_trial.unavailable: Record unavailable participant explicitly, do not claim reduced effort or adoption.
